name: Kevin Stratvert
topic: How to design a message for a shared internet billboard: a Take The Wall preview walkthrough
text:
I make Take The Wall. Your website-building tutorials made me think the free designer could suit a short walkthrough: create a project or birthday message, arrange the content, and compare desktop/mobile previews.

https://www.takethewall.com/?take=1

The unusual part is the live site: one page, one owner, replaced by the next activated takeover. Previewing needs no purchase; live placement has optional paid checkout and a reviewed free email-entry route. No guaranteed duration or audience.

This is a video suggestion, not a paid sponsorship or a request for endorsement. Happy to answer product questions at contact@takethewall.com.
